annotations: 50 ways on 8 Maryland urban roads whose level rested on an MDOT SHA count taken past a junction with another busy road (reports/borrowed-counts/JUDGMENT.md, 'urban street' rows). Each is rated from its own traffic (its own counts nearby, or the section's count less the joining road's) by the BRIEF urban anchors. Roads whose own traffic gives the same or a higher level, or with no usable estimate, are left as they are.
